Description.Text: This game exercises ADRIFT task actions implemented in FrankenDrift: MoveObject/MoveCharacter (including bulk targets), groups, SetProperty, variables, SetTasks, Time, conversation, EndGame, and event/walk controls.
A laboratory for testing task actions. Exits lead east to the store and south to the yard.
